listingTitle: Keep blocking Python APIs out of async functions
title: Keep blocking Python APIs out of async functions
why: A synchronous sleep, HTTP request, or subprocess call blocks the event-loop thread and delays unrelated coroutines.
suggestion: Use the library's async API or move unavoidable blocking work to asyncio.to_thread.
limitations: Only direct time.sleep, requests.get, requests.post, and subprocess.run calls inside async def bodies are recognized.
Aliases, wrappers, executor offloading on surrounding lines, and third-party blocking APIs are not inferred.
